replies.user_post: Self custody eliminates exchange risk. It doesn't eliminate security risk. Who generated your seed? On what machine? Could you recover without the vendor's app?
replies.reply: The third question catches the most people. A standard 12 or 24 word seed should open in any compatible wallet, so loading it into a second, unrelated app once tells you whether you'd still get in if the vendor's app disappeared.
replies.draft: Agreed. Test the recovery before you need it, ideally on a device you trust, and never on a machine you wouldn't trust with the funds.
replies.note: Cuenta nueva de marca de wallets, posible promoción.
